tools.name: mova_run
tools.description: Start a MOVA contract execution. Before calling, read the manifest resource mova://contracts/{contract_type}/manifest to understand required inputs (DataSpec) and available decision options. Built-in contract types: invoice, po, trade, aml, complaint, compliance, credit, supply_chain, churn, contract_gen. For custom registered contracts use mova_contract with action=run.

contract_type.description: Built-in type: invoice | po | trade | aml | complaint | compliance | credit | supply_chain | churn | contract_gen

inputs.description: Contract inputs per the DataSpec in the manifest. Read mova://contracts/{contract_type}/manifest first.

tools.name: mova_decide
tools.description: Submit a human decision at a contract gate. Uses ENV kind env.decision.submit_v0. contract_id comes from the mova_run response, not from business IDs.

option.description: Decision option_id from the decision gate (e.g. approve, reject, escalate)

tools.name: mova_query
tools.description: Query contract state or retrieve the signed audit trail.

view.description: status = current state | audit = signed receipt | audit_compact = full event journal

tools.name: mova_registry
tools.description: Browse the MOVA contract marketplace, connector catalogue, or your own contracts.

scope.description: contracts = public marketplace | connectors = available connectors | my_contracts = your registered contracts

tools.name: mova_connector
tools.description: Manage connector overrides for your org. Overrides replace the sandbox mock with your real endpoint.

auth_value.description: Secret value — never echoed back in the response

tools.name: mova_contract
tools.description: Manage your own registered MOVA contracts: list, register, set visibility, delete, run, check run status, report step completion, or approve/reject a human gate.

run_id.description: run_id from a previous run action

step_id.description: step_id being completed or approved/rejected (from flow.json step.id)

outcome.description: Step outcome key matching flow.next map. Common values: ok | default | invalid | approved

output.description: Structured output produced by the completed step (for step_complete)

source_url.description: HTTPS URL to the contract JSON

source_path.description: Local filesystem path to a contract flow JSON. mova-mcp reads it locally and sends inline flow payload to the backend.

execution_type.description: agent = executed locally by Claude Code (flow.json returned) | server = executed server-side via HITL engine

inputs.description: Input key-value pairs for run action

tools.name: mova_health
tools.description: Check MOVA runner health: config completeness, API connectivity, registered validator count, version.
